features.quote: Cap turns (e.g., 25). Most degradation onset happens early; a survival curve tells you if you're truncating signal.
features.justification_quote: Long tails are expensive and add little.

features.quote: reproduction rate is not a fixed property of the model... If you optimize the task designs for trigger rate, your headline metric partly reflects your own engineering effort
features.justification_quote: it won't be comparable across time as you refine tasks. The thing you actually want to regression-test... requires holding the provocation fixed

features.quote: I'd push back on once more: I'd treat 'reproduction rate' as a development-time signal... treat the control contrast + appropriate-termination rate as your actual regression-gate metrics.
features.justification_quote: The former rewards good provocation; the latter rewards model robustness, which is what you're trying to protect.
